startup.readiness: post-renderer adapter milestone, not first presentation
startup.memorySampling: single endpoint after idle settling for configured warmupSeconds

hover.input: native Linux persistent uinput absolute mouse through compositor
hover.trajectory: serpentine-v1, row-major cell indices, sampled cell centers, first target at phase time zero
hover.durationNote: Default 10s measures a prefix, full sweep requires duration >=15s
hover.supportedSession: Linux Wayland desktop with exactly one advertised connected wl_output, read/write /dev/uinput access arranged outside runner
hover.backendSelection: child environment preserved, report public native toolkit backend or unspecified separately from input driver
hover.targetRequirements: single current landscape output mode with scale1 and normal unrotated transform, actual adapter logical viewport equals full output dimensions, client origin (0,0), both dimensions >740 for grid and local (740,740) park
hover.reset: untimed pointer park at known local (740,740), HoverReset acknowledgment and 250ms settle before CPU baseline and Start, measured observations cleared by Start and Reset, no validation probes
hover.timing: scoped independent input scheduler, fixed60Hz absolute monotonic deadlines from received Started, no catch-up or dropped motions, kernel write and input endpoint at most 5ms late, exact native observations required
hover.operatorRequirement: untouched desktop with the full grid visible and stationary, no physical input, overlays, window moves, scaling or output changes
hover.interferenceLimit: no global focus, occlusion, held-button, modifier or physical-device attribution checks, initial output geometry and exact timed target observations cannot detect all transient interference
hover.verification: ordered native per-cell enter/current observations must exactly equal separately recorded submitted targets, duplicates while in same cell ignored, leave supported, no timed probe IPC
hover.provenance: HoverReady retains actual native backend/scale/viewport, HoverGeometry retains wl_output global/current dimensions/scale/normal transform and matching actual logical viewport, HoverInput retains submitted targets, cadence, lateness, input endpoint, CPU-counter completion and finish-request completion, HoverResources retains separate CPU baseline/endpoint read spans, root identity, conservative new-process cutoff, used membership scan spans/counts and actual memory acquisition spans/final completion, HoverCompleted retains exact native observations and verification, failed phases retain events.json
hover.cpuWindow: fresh tracked-member CPU baseline after initial memory acquisition and before Start, endpoint tracked-member CPU read completion within 5ms of fixed input endpoint, initial/final memory acquisition and drain cannot extend CPU attribution, actual baseline/endpoint read start and completion times retained
hover.cpuMembership: same nominal100ms process-tree discovery for every toolkit, missed resource slots skipped, root PID/start identity verified, children born after last discovery and short-lived processes may be missed, newly discovered pre-existing processes receive no pre-baseline work credit, conservative boot-clock cutoff may omit initial work around baseline
hover.memoryWindow: actual acquisition start/completion timestamps and elapsedMs completion time, final sample after input endpoint may overlap native drain but never extends CPU accounting, RSS/PSS only from actual final sample where available, no older substitute, peak includes actual initial/periodic/final samples
hover.resourceLatencyEnforcement: synchronous read acceptance bounds checked on return, not interruptible kernel-read timeouts
hover.mapping: two standard public Wayland registry/wl_output round trips before device creation, map local cell centers directly into 0..65535 using actual output width and height, no discovery, probes, fitting, scans or fallbacks
hover.fullscreen: adapter requests fullscreen, runner verifies actual logical viewport dimensions equal output, no independent native fullscreen-state inspection

authority: Current executable workload constants live in benchmark-common and toolkit adapters. This file describes the versioned contract, not runtime overrides.
